correctionNotes: Use the Crinacle 711 AutoEq measured correction for DUNU SA6 (default mode) as the base measurement-derived compensation.
For Crinacle IEF Preference 2025 on IEC 711, add the preference direction of a strong 105 Hz bass shelf and a broad -4 dB high shelf around 2500 Hz, while keeping enough preamp headroom.
Treat 5-8 kHz detail/resonance adjustments carefully because 711 IEM treble is coupler- and insertion-dependent.
signature: Balanced all-BA IEM profile registered from Crinacle 711/AutoEq measurement; tuned here toward Crinacle IEF Preference 2025 with strong sub-bass weight and relaxed upper treble.
source: AutoEq result from crinacle/711 in-ear: DUNU SA6 (default mode), plus Crinacle/In-Ear Fidelity article 'The New 2025 IEF Target' for IEF Preference 2025 IEC 711 target parameters.
